summary: Frontend-only verification of PaymentModal blur bug fix and cross-view design consistency for Kedai Kopi Selasar POS (React 19 + Vite, Delivero-inspired design). Reproduced the full mobile flow (product → add-to-cart → cart sheet → Bayar → PaymentModal) at 414x900 viewport and verified all computed styles. The mobile PaymentModal is now fully solid white (no blur/transparency), fullscreen edge-to-edge, and all payment methods + Konfirmasi Lunas footer button are visible & tappable. Desktop retains the centered card variant with rounded corners and blurred backdrop overlay as intended. All other views (Login, PIN, KDS, Meja, Reports, Settings) render normally under body.pos-delivero-active with no blur-leak on top-level content.
critical_code_review_comments: PosScreen.jsx line 578-584: the Bayar button is silently disabled when customerType='Dine-In' with no selected table. Since default state is Dine-In and no default table is chosen, first-time users on mobile may click Bayar with no visible feedback. Consider showing an inline hint 'Pilih meja dulu' below the button, or toast on click of disabled button.
handleStartPayment (line 208): uses native alert() for stock-issue notifications. Recommend replacing with the existing modal/toast system for consistency with the Delivero design language.

PaymentModal.jsx uses class 'modal-overlay payment-overlay' — good. Consider adding data-testid to .payment-overlay, .payment-modal, and each payment method button for future automated tests (currently only class-based selectors work).
PosScreen.jsx 634 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting cart sidebar / mobile cart sheet into subcomponents.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (payment blur bug fix verified, all 9 style assertions passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PaymentModal mobile bug is FIXED. Verified computed styles at viewport 414x900: overlay bg=rgb(255,255,255), backdrop-filter=none, modal bg=rgb(255,255,255), isolation=isolate, border-radius=0, size=414x900 (fullscreen), header/body/footer all bg white with backdrop-filter none. Desktop at 1440x900: modal w=620px, border-radius=24px, overlay has blur(6px) with dark tint — correct desktop behavior. To reproduce flow: viewport 414x900, click .product-card, click .modal-footer .checkout-btn (add), click .mobile-cart-float-btn, click Takeaway toggle (or select a table) to enable Bayar, then invoke .pos-cart-sidebar .checkout-btn onClick via JS (the button is technically below the initial scrollport so playwright .click() reports 'outside viewport' — use page.evaluate to scrollIntoView + click, or scroll the .pos-cart-sidebar inner scroll container first). No other pages showed any blur-leak or errors.
rca of the issue: Original bug: .payment-overlay used backdrop-filter:blur(10px) and .payment-modal (modal-card) inherited a semi-transparent card background from the generic .modal-card rule, which combined with the backdrop-filter's stacking-context bleed produced a fully-blurred appearance in mobile fullscreen where the modal fills the entire viewport. Fix applied in /app/src/styles/pos-delivero.css (lines 1720-1791): (a) .payment-modal now has background:#FFFFFF !important, isolation:isolate, backdrop-filter:none; (b) mobile media query overrides .payment-overlay to background:white with backdrop-filter:none (removes blur when the sheet is fullscreen anyway); (c) all .payment-modal .modal-header/.modal-body/.modal-footer forced to backdrop-filter:none so no descendant re-introduces blur. Verified via getComputedStyle in Playwright — every assertion passes.
